questions.question: Which element replaced eka aluminium according to the Mendeleev’s periodic table?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Gallium.**__

__
 
• **Gallium** replaced eka-Aluminium in Mendeleev's Periodic Table. While developing his Periodic Table of the elements, Mendeleev found some elements missing, which later would be found and named **Gallium, aka-Aluminum**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **When Mendeleev proposed his periodic table,** he noted gaps in the table and predicted that then-unknown elements existed with properties appropriate to fill those gaps.
 
• He named them eka-boron, eka-aluminum, eka-silicon, and eka-manganese, with respective atomic masses of 44, 68, 72, and 100.
 
• Eka prefix means that element occuring after suffix atom. Means Eka aluminium is Gallium. And Eka silicon is Germanium.
 
• It lies in group 3 of the Mendeleev's periodic table and thus, has a valency of 3.
 
• The formula of its** chloride is GaCl₃.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mendeleev **created a periodic table of all the elements that were known at the time**. 
 
• The **rows** of the table, called **periods**, each contained eight elements that increased in atomic mass from left to right.
 
• The **columns** of the table, called **groups**, contained elements with similar properties.

questions.question: In which year was the POSHAN Abhiyaan launched to emphasise the nutritional status of adolescent girls, pregnant women, lactating mothers, and children in the age group of 0-6 years?

• The programme, through use of technology, convergence and community involvement with a targeted approach strives to reduce the level of stunning, under-nutrition, Anemia and low birth weight in children, as also focus on adolescent girls, pregnant women and lactating mothers, thus holistically addressing **malnutrition**.
 
• The Abhiyaan is being implemented in all districts of Haryana. Nuh and Panipat districts were selected for **Phase-I**. 
 
• For **Phase-II**, 10 districts, namely Kaithal, Karnal, Kurukshetra, Bhiwani, Yamuna Nagar, Gurugram, Palwal, Rohtak, Sirsa and Sonipat were selected. Remaining districts are covered in the **Phase III**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• This month highlights the importance and role of the right nutrition for the human body.
 
• POSHAN Abhiyaan (National Nutrition Mission) is a flagship programme of the **Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD)**, Government of India, 
 
• The Ministry of Women and Child Development is headed by **Hon'ble Minister Smt. Smriti Zubin Irani.**

questions.question: Identify the chemical name for Ge.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Germanium.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Germanium** is a chemical element with the symbol **Ge **and** atomic number 32.**
 
• It is a lustrous, hard-brittle, grayish-white metalloid in the carbon group, chemically similar to its group neighbors **silicon and tin**.
 
• Pure germanium is a semiconductor with an appearance similar to elemental silicon.
 
• **Germanium atom forms four covalent bonds with the four neighboring atoms**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Gallium is a chemical element with the symbol Ga and atomic number 31.
 
• Gold is a chemical element with the symbol Au and atomic number 79, making it one of the higher atomic number elements that occur naturally. 
 
• Gadolinium is a chemical element with the symbol Gd and atomic number 64. Gadolinium is a silvery-white metal when oxidation is removed. 
 
• **Covalent Bond:__**
 __
 
• **​__T****he interatomic linkage that results from the sharing of an electron pair between two atoms**. 
 
• The binding arises from the electrostatic attraction of their nuclei for the same electrons.
 
• **Example**: **Water (H₂O)** A water molecule consists of two hydrogens and one oxygen (O) atom. Oxygen has a valency of two, and hydrogen has only one electron in its orbital. So, each hydrogen atom will share its electron and covalently bond with the oxygen.

questions.question: What percentage of the rural population uses safe and functional toilets as per the 2019-20 National Sample Survey report?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__95%.__**

__
 
• As per the results of NARSS 2019-20, 99.6% of the households who had access to toilets, and had availability of water, and **95.2%** of the rural population who had access to a toilet, were using it.
 
• Government launched Jal Jeevan Mission in 2019 with the goal to provide functional household tap connection to every rural household by 2024.
 
• According to 2019 data, **98.21%** of the country has achieved ODF Status and has full access to toilets.
 
• The National Annual Rural Sanitation Survey, 2019-2020, showed that **0.8 percent** of the population in rural areas had no toilets and practiced open defecation; the figure was 6.8 per cent in 2018-2019; and 23 percent in 2017-2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• A recent joint monitoring program(JMP) on water, sanitation, and hygiene by the World Health Organization and UNICEF released July 1, 2021, stated that at least 15 percent of the total population in India defecates in the open. 
 
• The Joint Monitoring Report also emphasized universal access to water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) to achieve the United Nations-mandated Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) .​
 
• According to census 2011 data, only **30.7%** of rural households had access to toilets in 2011. According to rural sanitation scheme data, the number was considerably larger at 79.9%.
 
• **Over 67 per cent** of rural households do not have access to toilets, according to government data.

questions.question: How many types of writs can be issued by the Supreme Court of India for the protection of Fundamental Rights?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Five.__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The Supreme Court of India is the defender of the fundamental rights of the citizens. For that, it has original and wide powers.
 
• It issues **five** kinds of writs for enforcing the fundamental rights of the citizens.
 
• **Writs:__**
 __
 
• ​Writs are a written order from the Supreme Court or High Court that commands constitutional remedies for Indian Citizens against the violation of their fundamental rights.
 
• **Article 32** in the Indian Constitution deals with constitutional remedies that an Indian citizen can seek from the Supreme Court of India and the High Court against the violation of his/her fundamental rights. 
 
• The same **article** gives the Supreme Court power to issue writs for the enforcement of rights whereas the High Court has the same power under **Article 226.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are** five types** of Writs which are:

 
 
• ​Habeas Corpus.
 
• Mandamus.
 
• Certiorari.
 
• Quo Warranto.
 
• Prohibition.
 
 
 
• ​ All these writs are an effective method of enforcing the rights of the people and compelling the authorities to fulfill the duties which are bound to perform under the law.

questions.question: In January 2021, which state/Union Territory issued its ‘School Bag Policy 2020’, according to which the weight of the school bag should be at a maximum of 3.5 kgs to 5 kgs?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• School Bag Policy 2020: **The government of Delhi** has issued guidelines to reduce the weight of school bags for the students in primary, secondary as well as senior secondary levels, according to news agency ANI.
 
• According to the new guidelines, the weight of the school bag should be at a maximum of **3.5 kgs to 5 kgs. **
 
• The guidelines have been issued under the School Bag Policy 2020, which had been drawn by experts from **NCERT, CBSE, Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS), and Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS).**
 
• It was released by the **Union Ministry of Education and NCERT** in November previous year and shared with the Education Secretaries of **all the states too the Union Territories.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **​** **The State of Karnataka has recently limited a load of school bags in May 2019**.
 
• The National Education Policy (NEP) of 2020 **provides an important opportunity to move Indian education from “sorting and selection” to “human development,” enabling every student to develop to their maximum potential**.
 
• NEP 2020 aims to **increase the Gross Enrolment Ratio in higher education including vocational education from 26.3% (2018) to 50% by 2035**.
 
• ** 3.5 Crore new seats will be added to Higher education institutions.**

questions.question: Which of the following groups consists of elements that are non-reactive, monoatomic elements with extremely low boiling points?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Group 18.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Group 18 elements include** Helium(He), Neon(Ne), Argon(Ar), Krypton(Kr), Xenon(Xe), and Radon(Rn). **
 
• They are mentioned as **noble gases or inert gases.**
 
• This means that these elements are** chemically inert **and **do not participate in any reaction.**
 
• The noble gases have a **weak interatomic force** and accordingly have** very low melting and boiling points.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Group-16** elements are also called **chalcogens**. They are called so **because most of the copper ores have copper in the form of oxides and sulphides**.
 
• **Group 15** of the periodic table is also called the **nitrogen group.**
 
• The elements of the Boron Family are called Icosagens as **this name was proposed to design the elements in Group 13**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c60938a3ec8c89dd8b668312d0d88279834857988e79706a28123617cc595519.png]

questions.question: Which of the following is a mountain pass in the Pir Panjal range at a maximum altitude of 2832 metres that connects the Kashmir Valley in the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir with the Outer Himalayas and the plains in the south?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Banihal Pass**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Banihal Pass **is a mountain pass across the Pir Panjal Range at a maximum elevation of 2,832 m (9,291 ft).
 
• It** joins **the Kashmir Valley in the union territory of Jammu and Kashmir to the outer Himalayas and the plains to the south.
 
• The road from **Jammu to Srinagar transversed Banihal Pass until 1956 when the Jawahar Tunnel was constructed under the pass.**
 
• The road now passes through the underpass and the **Banihal Pass is no longer used for road transport.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mana Pass is located **within the Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve, 47 km north of the town of Mana, India, and 52 km north of the Hindu pilgrimage town of Badrinath in Uttarakhand**.
 
• Bara-lacha la also known as Bara-lacha Pass, (el. 4,850 m or 15,910 ft) is a high mountain pass in the Zanskar range, connecting **Lahaul district in Himachal Pradesh to Leh district in Ladakh**.
 
• Zoji-La Pass is a high mountain pass that runs **through the Kashmir valley to Ladakh**.

questions.question: Identify the cell that is amoeboid in shape.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**White blood cells**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• At the site of infection, **white blood cells accumulate to destroy pathogens.**
 
• Their amoeboid shape **assists them to squeeze through blood capillaries** and at the same time their pseudopodia help to kill pathogens by the process of **phagocytosis**.
 
• White blood cells are **part of the body's immune system**.
 
• They help the body **fight infection and other diseases.**
 
• Types of white blood cells are **granulocytes (neutrophils, eosinophils, and basophils), monocytes, and lymphocytes (T cells and B cells).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb198b98c82ec9fdb71f180b40ddf60d9681f3d6870ab1f68f6f8f464b5b0c8f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**The basic unit of communication in the nervous system** is the nerve cell (neuron).
 
• The simple columnar epithelium is a **single layer of columnar epithelial cells** that are **tall and slender with oval-shaped nuclei located in the basal region, attached to the basement membrane**.
 
• **Red blood cells **contain a protein called **hemoglobin,** which **carries oxygen from the lungs to all parts of the body.**
